data.overview: A former military sharpshooter living under an assumed name is found by the warlord who once imprisoned her. With the daughter she raised now in danger, she turns a remote farm into the ground for a desperate defense.
data.tagline: Her aim is all that stands between them.
data.title: The Quiet Marksman
